notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Good news don't get lost players!

The last set of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1442360/view/3711570157938322727]beta updates[/url] are now available in the main game.

Have fun, and keep your eyes peeled for the next beta update!

If, for whatever reason, you want to delay getting these updates, you can select the "previous" branch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1442360/announcements/detail/3675537557870988476]in the same way[/url] you would select the "beta" branch.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved character combat
[*] Aggressive characters now loose interest in the player if they cant reach them
[*] Holding ctrl whilst translating a building snaps to 1 unit increments
[*] Added recipes for market stall and pizza oven
[*] Re-balanced the value of many items
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed item teleport bug to perfectly vertical gutters
[*] Fixed bug when inspecting certain items in inventory causes
[*] Prioritization scheme for machines with multiple network adapters
[/list]

Aggressive characters now loose interest in the player if they cant reach them
Holding ctrl whilst translating a building snaps to 1 unit increments
Added recipes for market stall and pizza oven

tags.balance_change: Re-balanced the value of many items

tags.bug: Fixed item teleport bug to perfectly vertical gutters
Fixed bug when inspecting certain items in inventory causes
Prioritization scheme for machines with multiple network adapters

notes.title: Beta update
notes.content:
Hello Don't get lost players!

The opt-in beta just got an update - see the changelog below. More detail can be found on the  [url=https://github.com/miicck/dont-get-lost]github page[/url].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1442360/view/3675537557870988475]How to opt-in to the beta[/url]. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added recipe for railway stops
[*] Improved railway linking
[*] Improved railway messages
[*] Improved balancing for trader items
[*] Removed player collisions with traders
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved network performance of signs
[*] Mushrooms now show up in gutters/pantry
[*] Fixed tab-info screen in inventory for some specific items 
[*] Fixed fishing rod/noticeboard control locking
[*] Fixed getting stuck in menu if another player removes a log splitter
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Good news don't get lost players!

The last set of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1442360/announcements/detail/3654146727501225187]beta updates[/url] are now available in the main game.

Have fun, and keep your eyes peeled for the next beta update!

If, for whatever reason, you want to delay getting these updates, you can select the "previous" branch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1442360/announcements/detail/3675537557870988476]in the same way[/url] you would select the "beta" branch.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Autosaving works automatically - no longer need to copy/rename autosave files
[*] Can now start game without tutorial, or the example town
[*] Added method to delete items from inventory (small bin in top-right corner)
[*] Community contributors now automatically appear in the credits
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved description of tutorial camp setup
[*] Mitigated poor performance for large map render ranges
[*] Fixed equipment duplication bug in multiplayer
[*] Fixed player spawning inside objects when tutorial disabled
[*] Disabled building translation into tutorial area
[*] Dynamite no longer obtainable
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Good news don't get lost players!

Last week's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1442360/announcements/detail/3675537557870988476]beta updates[/url] are now available in the main game.

Have fun, and keep your eyes peeled for the next beta update!

If, for whatever reason, you want to delay getting these updates, you can select the "previous" branch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1442360/announcements/detail/3675537557870988476]in the same way[/url] you would select the "beta" branch.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]UI updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a UI scaling option
[*] Made UI more readable in several places
[*] Inspection UI now grows to content
[/list]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added ability to set keybinds
[*] Added inverted mouse option
[*] Added automatic credit for git contributions
[*] Added baked potato
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed player-settler collision
[*] Fixed portal in tutorial area game freeze
[*] Default chest placement no longer underground
[*] Buffer chest blocks settler paths less easily
[*] Forestry/mining spots no longer reset on choice selection
[*] Fix infinite charcoal dupe
[*] Already-satisfied tutorial item requirements no longer break UI
[*] Trees in tabletop mountain biome now have wood
[*] Fixed some items not displaying properly in trader menu
[*] Disabled dragging of buildings into tutorial area
[*] Using all of an equipped item no longer leaves it equipped
[*] vSync enabled by default
[/list]

notes.title: Beta update
notes.content:
Hello Don't get lost players!

Following on from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1442360/view/3635003893227927542?l=english]initial roadmap[/url] post, I'm pleased to be releasing the first beta update! This contains community-driven bugfixes and QOL updates. Thanks to all those who reported bugs on the [url=https://discord.gg/xcfn9Q7KHh]discord[/url], on [url=https://github.com/miicck/dont-get-lost/issues]github[/url] or on the community pages ːsteamhappyː

The update will be released as an opt-in beta version initially and, once determined to be stable, released into the main version. If you want to opt-in, follow the instructions below:
